name: Eleanor Ainsworth
bio:
Eleanor's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing herself, but through a fascination with the engineering behind it. She excelled in her mechanical engineering degree, focusing on aerodynamics and material science. Her career started at a smaller Formula series team, where she quickly rose through the ranks, demonstrating a keen eye for identifying performance gains and a relentless drive to improve car setup. 

Her approach to the technical director role is characterized by a data-driven methodology combined with an understanding of driver feedback. Eleanor is known for her ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable strategies for the track. At 23XI Racing, she aims to foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, believing that the team's success lies in its ability to adapt and push boundaries. Her calm demeanor under pressure distinguishes her, allowing her to make critical decisions even in the most stressful race conditions.

physical.hairStyle: Straight, shoulder-length hair often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Eleanor is of average height with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on a precisely organized workspace, with every tool and document in its designated place.
